title: ESP-NOW Testing
objective: Confirm ESP-NOW pairing, message stability, and retry behaviour between devices.
hypothesis: ESP-NOW will be more reliable than the current fallback link for short-range local messaging.
test_plan: Pair two nodes, send repeated payloads, track dropped packets, and note retry requirements.
setup_notes: Use a quiet RF environment and a fixed message payload size.
lesson_learned: Communication tests should start with the smallest stable payload.
